metadata.description: Marketplace for the slipway plugin (Agentic Delivery Lifecycle): repo intake, containerisation, Terraform on Azure, per-app GitHub Actions CI/CD with immutable tags, deployment verification and Jira tracking. The same plugin directory also installs in Claude Code (.claude-plugin/marketplace.json).

plugins.name: slipway
plugins.description: Agentic Delivery Lifecycle: interview-driven intake of a repo, app classification, hardened multi-stage Dockerfiles, Terraform (Azure), one CI and one CD per app with immutable tags, deployment verification and Jira tracking. Option-based: cloud, compute, registry, runner, versioning, branching, tracker and secret store are chosen per repo.
